newsitem.title: USA: R.P. Scherer, Oxoid Ltd in license pact.
newsitem.headline: R.P. Scherer, Oxoid Ltd in license pact.

text.p: R.P. Scherer Corp said its affiliate, Scherer DDS Ltd, and Oxoid Ltd, an international microbiological company, entered into a license and supply agreement covering Scherer's Pulsincap technology.
The use of the Pulsincap capsules is expected to reduce by up to 50 percent the time required to test foods for bacterial contamination.
The agreement covers commercial arrangements for the exclusive worldwide use of the patented technology in test kits for the detection of specific bacterial contamination in foods.
The initial launches are expected to take place within the next 12 months.
Oxoid is based in Basingstoke in the United Kingdom.
